# get_energy_interpolator { #mofography.compute.get_energy_interpolator }

`compute.get_energy_interpolator(egrid)`

This function creates a 3D regular grid interpolator for energy values given an input energy grid.

## Parameters

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                | Default    |
|---------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `egrid` |        | a 3D numpy array representing a grid of energy values. The shape of the array should be (n_x, n_y, n_z), where n_x, n_y, and n_z are the number of grid points in the x, y, and z directions, respectively | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                                                                                    |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | a RegularGridInterpolator object that can be used to interpolate values from a 3D energy grid. |
